Hi Irene / Oliver,

Thanks for the packet and the clear questions. TL;DR — we need the legal name and EIN to match the tax form exactly for the vendor master; remit/display name can be a DBA but we require a supporting document if invoices will use a DBA. The redacted bank letter is helpful but not enough for live ACH.

Specific items we need to close vendor creation and enable POs:
1) A corrected W-9 where the "Name (as shown on your income tax return)" matches the corporate/legal name you want in our system (Veridian Instruments, Inc.). If you want the DBA to appear on invoices, include the DBA as "Remit/Invoice As" in the onboarding_form.
2) Bank letter on company letterhead confirming the account number or a voided company check (we cannot accept redacted account numbers).
3) Vendor contact for invoice disputes (name + direct email + phone).
4) Confirmation of the remit address for AP (street, city, state, zip).

PO process notes:
- PO numbers follow the format RW-YYYY-##### (we'll provide one when the purchase is created).
- Standard payment terms are Net 30 unless negotiated. Please flag if Veridian requires different terms.
- If invoices are issued to a DBA, include a copy of the DBA registration or a signed letter authorizing the DBA to invoice on behalf of the legal entity.

Estimated timeline: if we receive the corrected W-9 and bank letter today, we can complete vendor creation within 2 business days and issue first PO within 3-5 business days.

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf to make it easier for your AP. Once we have the corrected docs I'll create the vendor master record and update Irene.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
